description: Tarquin-owned LEG shared surface for Arrow import/check. Build-time contract, not a runtime dependency. v0.2 reconciles the field-4 naming contradiction surfaced by the Fable 5 review (v0.1 asserted Action while Arrow v1.5.2 shipped Control): Arrow v1.6.0-draft has now executed the final rename to Action. v0.2 also pins (rule_id, semantic_slug) pairs per the Arrow rule-ID permanence policy and corrects the stale LEG rule numbering carried in v0.1.

arrow_alignment.naming_freeze: Field-4 name Action and rule IDs ACT-001/ACT-002 are final. Arrow rule identifiers are permanent from v1.6.0: retired, never renumbered, never reused.
arrow_alignment.rfc_note: Arrow RFC-008 v0.3 is historical design provenance for the Action/Class-4/TR/CL disentanglement. This machine-readable contract aligns to the v1.6.0 protocol and registry artifacts, not to RFC draft paths.

canonical_field_4.alias_rule: ALS-001: where a JSON artifact carries both a legacy and the canonical field name, values MUST be equal or the artifact is rejected. Aliases accepted on input, never emitted in new artifacts, never crossing a bridge.
canonical_field_4.notes: The canonical six-field wire string never carried a field label; the rename is name-layer only.

class_terminology.notes: Control-plane event class: registry updates, chain/bridge status transitions, protocol upgrades, validator/DVN/OVN topology changes, parameter changes, emergency declarations, supersession. Not the Action field; not Origin PCY. The v0.1 compact alias CTR is dropped (one letter from the retired CTL-* rule family).
Bidirectionally bound to Action CL as of Arrow v1.6.0: SEM-005 (Class 6 ⇒ CL) and SEM-020 (CL ⇒ Class 6). Only valid closure shape: 6:*:FN:CL:1:*.

origins.name: policy_governance_origin
origins.notes: PCY remains the governance/policy source domain. 'Policy' now appears in exactly this one canonical namespace.

actions.name: trigger
actions.notes: TR triggers a specified downstream workflow with an explicit action_target envelope, object, and authorizing event (TRG-001 draft). Permitted classes {2,5}. Never generic PR; never itself proof of transfer; never directly executable at the consumer (LC-002).

actions.name: closed
actions.notes: Terminal Action, bidirectionally bound to Class 6 (live in Arrow v1.6.0, fixture F-12). Post-closure events: LFC-007 reserved — SEM-014 reversal/supersession referencing the CL event only.

follow_up_event_model.affirmed: new event, same lifecycle_id, State FN, Finality 1, references FN+0 event in related_events; promotion is always a new event, never wall-clock
follow_up_event_model.reversed: Class 1, State RV, references reversed event (SEM-014)
follow_up_event_model.post_closure: LFC-007 (reserved): only SEM-014 reversal or Class 4 CONTROL/SUPERSESSION referencing the CL event
follow_up_event_model.invariant: A lifecycle without a Class 6 CL event is live and MUST be monitored for follow-up events; lifecycles can only end through Class 6.

states.name: timelocked
states.notes: TL is a State value only. It is not an Action code.

verification_regimes.notes: Manual or institutionally reviewed legal attestation fallback.
Single Sibyl/LBRY structured proof path. B requires verified LBRY signature under OA-014.
Independent multi-Sibyl evidence path. Tier-3 remains SO-001 gated; until the independence-evidence object is defined this regime must not be minted.

confidence.notes: A is reserved for a future legal-native regime. B is a ceiling, not a default.

arrow_rule_pins.policy: Pinned (rule_id, semantic_slug) pairs. A drift between an ID and its slug on either side fails CI. Corrects v0.1, which carried pre-v1.5.1 numbering (the derivation gate was cited as LEG-007).

leg_006_derivation.notes: v0.1 treated the derivation matrix (cited under its pre-v1.5.1 number LEG-007) as an incomplete monolithic object gating real PR. Per the Fable 5 review, the matrix exists in factored form: LEG-006 (subtype × Finality=1 → permitted Action set) + SEM-013 (Finality=0 row) + SEM-015 (regime → confidence ceiling) + LEG-004/LEG-005 (confidence → action floors). The remaining ask on Arrow is a generated, hash-pinned derived-matrix export (exports/leg-derivation-matrix.v1.json) computed from these factors — never hand-edited — for OA-008 preflight and parity-corpus generation. Real on-chain PR remains gated on the consumer-side items (execution scope binding, execution-time re-validation), not on new matrix spec work.

minimal_common_denominator.notes: Restriction/review/cure family. AssetFreeze can derive from HL plus scope/duration metadata or BL for hard block.
Authorization/proceed family after full conjunctive gate and human ratification.

uncovered_actions.notes: No TransferOrder primitive until TRG-001 (action_target) and execution-scope binding land.
No lifecycle Closed primitive until LFC-007 lands. SEM-020 binding is live protocol-side.

primitive_bindings.notes: Stub; concrete deployment supplies ratifier authorization and execution effect.

solidity_alias_note: primitives/Types.sol field-4 enum is now Action (migration complete 2026-06-14). The on-chain Disposition field, generated RuleEngineV01.sol / RuleEngineParity.t.sol, and ruleEngine.ts all use Action; cross-target parity is green. No Policy alias remains in code.

arrow_import_contract.ci_expectation: Arrow fails CI if checked-in generated validation fixtures drift from this artifact or if the pinned hash changes without review. Rule-pin drift (rule_id vs slug) fails CI on both sides.
